name: Category performance
prompt: Compare product categories side by side: order value by category on one side and late delivery rate by category on the other, with category KPIs and a detail table of category metrics.

binding.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_value), 0) AS total_order_value FROM shipment_performance

copy.title: Total order value
copy.caption: $4.8M in shipped order value across eight categories.

binding.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1), 0.0) AS late_rate FROM shipment_performance WHERE status = 'delivered'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_shipments FROM shipment_performance WHERE is_late = TRUE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) AS category_count FROM shipment_performance

copy.title: Categories
copy.caption: Eight product categories shipped in the period.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  category AS category,
  SUM(order_value) AS total_order_value
FROM shipment_performance
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_order_value DESC
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Order value by category
copy.caption: Electronics leads at $762K, with Metals and Bearings close behind.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  category,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS late_rate_pct
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC, category
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Late rate by category
copy.caption: Chemicals and Packaging are the worst performers — both late 51% of the time.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  category,
  ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS total_order_value,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered' AND is_late) AS late_shipment_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered') AS delivered_shipment_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered' AND is_late)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered'), 0),
    1
  ) AS late_rate_pct
FROM shipment_performance
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST, total_order_value DESC
LIMIT 50

copy.title: Category shipment metrics
copy.caption: Order value, delivered counts and late rate for every category.
